name: If One Goes Astray
source:
An unexpected encounter with a long lost love carries consequences for Lizzie and Laura. Not least because Jeanie, Jeanie's dead.

...isn't she?

[From [url=https://butterflyrocket.itch.io/if-one-goes-astray]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莉齐和劳拉意外邂逅久违的挚爱，这给她带来了后果。尤其是因为珍妮，珍妮死了。

……她不是吗？
